title: WB-001 Pilot Round 1 - measurable lossless-compression advances

tasks: run the reference candidate on the public corpus
confirm exact round-trip and deterministic compressed hashes
read the no-holdout-access and full-cost-accounting rules

hard_rules: Decompression must reproduce every input byte exactly.
The candidate must be deterministic under the frozen protocol.
Every byte required for decoding, including headers and dictionaries, counts.
Encoder, decoder, memory, storage, and deployment costs must be reported.
Workers and agents must never receive the sealed holdout or hidden target result.
Independent reruns must use the frozen isolated security boundary and a per-assignment conflict declaration.
The holdout job token must be issued after and bind the exact confirming rerun-gate event.
Exact metrics and free-text annotations must not enter the public ledger while reruns are blind.
A changed artifact, method, corpus, baseline, or rule is a new attempt or successor round.
No result is promotion-eligible until two other human-owned reruns agree and the signed holdout gate passes.

lanes.title: Reversible preprocessing
lanes.goal: Expose structure to an existing codec without losing a byte or hiding transform overhead.
lanes.economic_question: Does the size gain repay transform CPU, memory, metadata, and decoder complexity?

lanes.title: Per-block codec and profile selection
lanes.goal: Select a codec or profile per block using deterministic observable features.
lanes.economic_question: Does adaptive selection beat the frozen frontier after selectors, headers, libraries, and latency are counted?

lanes.title: Dictionaries and domain detection
lanes.goal: Build and select reproducible dictionaries using only allowed training or public data.
lanes.economic_question: Does dictionary storage, distribution, cold-start, versioning, and decoder support remain viable?

work_units.title: Typed integer delta and zig-zag transforms
work_units.brief: Detect suitable fixed-width integer streams, transform reversibly, and measure false-positive and metadata costs.

work_units.title: Structured-text field and token transforms
work_units.brief: Test reversible field separation or token remapping on text-like classes without assuming a hidden schema.

work_units.title: Sparse and repeated-block transforms
work_units.brief: Explore exact sparse maps or repeated-block references with every map and index byte counted.

work_units.title: Cheap deterministic block features
work_units.brief: Find low-cost observable features that predict the useful part of the frozen codec frontier.

work_units.title: Deterministic codec/profile selection policy
work_units.brief: Construct a selection rule and count model, branch, header, and multi-decoder costs.

work_units.title: Block granularity versus overhead
work_units.brief: Map where smaller blocks help and where framing, ratio, memory, or latency makes them uneconomic.

work_units.title: Deterministic public-only dictionary construction
work_units.brief: Build byte-identical dictionaries from declared public inputs with no holdout access.

work_units.title: Content-domain detector
work_units.brief: Detect whether a known dictionary applies using bounded deterministic features and report misclassification costs.

work_units.title: Bounded dictionary catalog and wire format
work_units.brief: Test a small versioned catalog while counting dictionary bytes, identifiers, deployment, and fallback behaviour.
